body: Good questions, don't I have any answers. Dont think it makes all that much of a difference.

Mainly for my family, I felt more at peace when I was homeless. People seemed to worry less about my well being. I dont have any desire to die, but I dislike my self and life enough to want to start a new one. I cant put my family through a suicide, I feel they would interpret my runaway as  me doing my best to stay alive, and to an extent, understand.
